# Code of Conduct

[繁體中文](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) | [English](CODE_OF_CONDUCT_en.md)

AskMiao welcomes everyone to take part through issues, pull requests, and discussions. So that everyone can participate with confidence, all participants are expected to follow this Code of Conduct in every project space.

## Our pledge

Everyone here deserves respect and freedom from harassment and discrimination, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, sexual orientation, or the language they use.

## Expected behavior

- Respect differing viewpoints and experiences; critique ideas, not people.
- Give specific, constructive feedback, and accept feedback gracefully.
- Take responsibility for your mistakes, apologize to those affected, and learn from them.
- Be patient with newcomers, and explain with context or links to the documentation.
- Redact passwords, tokens, API keys, and personal data when reporting problems, to protect yourself and others.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Sexualized language or imagery, and sexual harassment or unwelcome advances of any kind.
- Trolling, insulting or derogatory comments, and personal attacks.
- Public or private harassment, including continuing to contact someone after they have asked you to stop.
- Publishing others' private information, such as a home address, phone number, or email address, without their consent.
- Disclosing details of an unpatched security vulnerability in a public issue, pull request, or discussion; report it privately as described in the [Security Policy](SECURITY_en.md) instead.
- Other conduct that could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies in all project spaces, including issues, pull requests, code reviews, discussions, and commit history on GitHub, and when someone represents the project in public.

## Maintainer responsibilities

The maintainer is responsible for interpreting and enforcing this Code of Conduct, may remove, edit, or reject comments, commits, code, issues, and other contributions that do not follow it, and will explain the reasons when appropriate.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness behavior that violates this Code of Conduct, email [yao921024@gmail.com](mailto:yao921024@gmail.com). If you can, include:

- Where and when it happened (a link to the issue, pull request, or comment).
- The people involved.
- What happened, with screenshots if needed.

Every report will be taken seriously and investigated. The maintainer will keep the reporter's identity and the details of the report confidential, and will not tolerate retaliation against anyone who reports.

If the report concerns the maintainer, or you would rather not send an email, you can [report it to GitHub](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam) directly.

## Enforcement

Depending on how serious the behavior is and whether it is repeated, the maintainer will take one of these actions:

| Situation | Action |
|---|---|
| Minor, possibly a misunderstanding, such as inappropriate wording | A private reminder explaining what was inappropriate; a public apology may be requested |
| A single more serious violation, or repeated minor ones | A formal warning with the consequences of further violations; no interaction with the people involved for a period of time |
| A serious violation, such as sustained inappropriate behavior | A temporary ban from interacting and participating in project spaces |
| Repeated violations, harassment of an individual, or attacks on or demeaning of a group of people | A permanent ban |

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is based on the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/), adapted for this project.
